text:
jon: Morning all — quick async for today, drop one-liners: what you shipped yesterday, any blockers, and one ask for the day.

maya: Shipped the model routing tests for fallback policy. Found flaky test on region failover, opened PR -> https://git.redwood/test/458 (needs review). No blockers besides that. Ask: can someone from infra skim the PR? :eyes:

alex: Reworked the batching config UI in console, rolled to staging. UX feedback went in. Blocker: staging creds mismatch with dev accounts (get 403). Ask: @devon can you help with staging IAM mapping?

sophia: Finished eval harness for the new quantized Llama variant. Initial perf looks good — ~12% latency win on 8k context. Blocker: need a couple more eval prompts from product for safety checks. Ask: @jon can you ping product?

liam: Fixed a crash in the KV cache eviction path (heap growth). Deployed hotfix to dedicated pool. No blockers. FYI: will monitor for the next 6 hours. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

devon: Took Alex's IAM issue — digging into staging role mapping now, should have a patch by EOD. Also rebased infra-automation PR. Ask: if anyone needs staging access this afternoon, DM me.

eva: FYI I updated observability alerts to reduce noisy retries on model fallback; added a 5m suppression window. Blocker: need to confirm alert thresholds for P95 tail. Ask: ops-reviewers, can you ack thresholds?

deploy-bot: deploy:prod: Job #2982 started by jon — rolling canary for dedicated autoscaler changes. Logs: `kubectl rollout status deploy/dedicated-autoscaler`

jon: Quick cross-team notes: 1) product should drop 3 safety prompts in #product by noon, 2) infra review of staging IAM is high priority (blocking releases), 3) ops please validate alert thresholds before EOD.

maya: Reviewed Alex's staging UI, small CSS nit. Will approve Alex's PR after IAM is fixed.

alex: Thx @maya — re: 403 I'll queue a small retry and a better error message so users see the reason instead of a generic 500.

sophia: Pinging product now.

liam: Monitoring logs — KV cache errors down after hotfix.

devon: IAM patch ready, pushing in 15m. Will update this thread when done.

eva: Reviewed alert thresholds and left a comment in the ops doc.

jon: Great, thanks everyone. If anything critical pops up, call a quick huddle. Otherwise post updates here. :thumbsup:
